label: Total population
sentence_label: total population
definition: Total resident population (ACS 5-year period estimate).
breaks: Controlled to Population Estimates for counties and larger areas (MOE shown as *****, i.e. no sampling error).
suppression: Estimates for very small areas may be unreliable.
limitations: Period estimate, not a point-in-time count; use decennial counts or annual estimates for trends in size.

label: Population (census count)
sentence_label: population (census count)
definition: Resident population counted in the decennial census on April 1.
breaks: Each count uses the boundaries at that census (annexations change places). 2020 counts include differential privacy noise at small geographies.
suppression: None for totals; 2020 disclosure avoidance adds noise below the state level.
limitations: Counts for places reflect the legal area at each census (evolving boundaries).

label: Housing units (census count)
sentence_label: number of housing units (census count)
definition: Housing units counted in the decennial census on April 1.
breaks: Boundaries change between censuses.
limitations: Counts reflect the legal area at each census.

label: Median age
sentence_label: median age
definition: Age that divides the population into two equal groups (published median, years).
suppression: Medians in open-ended intervals are shown as bounds.
limitations: Cannot be combined across areas from published tables (no single-year age distribution in B01002); shown for each member instead.

label: Under 5 years
sentence_label: share of residents under 5
definition: Share of residents under age 5.

label: 5 to 17 years
sentence_label: share of residents aged 5 to 17
definition: Share of residents aged 5 to 17.

label: 18 to 24 years
sentence_label: share of residents aged 18 to 24
definition: Share of residents aged 18 to 24.

label: 25 to 44 years
sentence_label: share of residents aged 25 to 44
definition: Share of residents aged 25 to 44.

label: 45 to 64 years
sentence_label: share of residents aged 45 to 64
definition: Share of residents aged 45 to 64.

label: 65 years and over
sentence_label: share of residents aged 65 and over
definition: Share of residents aged 65 and over.

label: Hispanic or Latino
sentence_label: Hispanic or Latino share of residents
definition: Share of residents who are Hispanic or Latino (of any race).
breaks: Race and Hispanic origin coding improved from 2020 data; comparisons across 2020 need caution (Census Bureau).

label: White alone, not Hispanic
sentence_label: non-Hispanic White share of residents
definition: Share of residents who identify as White alone and not Hispanic or Latino.
breaks: Race coding improved from 2020 data; 'alone' categories fell partly because more people were coded as multiracial.

label: Black alone, not Hispanic
sentence_label: non-Hispanic Black share of residents
definition: Share of residents who identify as Black or African American alone and not Hispanic or Latino.
breaks: Race coding improved from 2020 data.

label: Asian alone, not Hispanic
sentence_label: non-Hispanic Asian share of residents
definition: Share of residents who identify as Asian alone and not Hispanic or Latino.
breaks: Race coding improved from 2020 data.

label: Two or more races, not Hispanic
sentence_label: non-Hispanic multiracial share of residents
definition: Share of residents who identify with two or more races and are not Hispanic or Latino.
breaks: Improved coding of write-in responses from 2020 raised multiracial counts; the increase is partly a measurement change.

label: Other single race, not Hispanic
sentence_label: share of residents in other single-race groups (non-Hispanic)
definition: Share of residents who identify as American Indian and Alaska Native, Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander, or some other race alone, and not Hispanic or Latino.
breaks: Race coding improved from 2020 data.
limitations: Combines three smaller groups for readability; each is published separately in B03002.

label: Median household income
sentence_label: median household income
definition: Median income in the past 12 months of all households, in dollars of the final year of the period.
suppression: Medians in the open-ended top interval are shown as bounds (e.g. $250,000+).
limitations: Combined areas: interpolated from the summed 16-bin distribution; differs slightly from Census medians (computed from finer internal distributions); MOE not computed.

label: Per capita income
sentence_label: per capita income
definition: Aggregate income in the past 12 months divided by total population, in dollars of the final year of the period.
limitations: Survey-based; differs from BEA per capita personal income (a national-accounts measure).

label: Poverty rate
sentence_label: poverty rate
definition: Share of people for whom poverty status is determined whose income is below the official poverty threshold.
universe: People for whom poverty status is determined
limitations: Excludes people in institutions, military group quarters, college dormitories and unrelated children under 15.

label: Child poverty rate (under 18)
sentence_label: poverty rate for children under 18
definition: Share of children under 18 for whom poverty status is determined who are below the poverty threshold.
universe: Children under 18 for whom poverty status is determined
breaks: B17020 is not published in the 2005-2009 release.

label: Labor force participation rate
sentence_label: labor force participation rate
definition: Share of residents aged 16 and over who are in the labor force (employed or unemployed).
breaks: B23025 is not published in the 2005-2009 release.
limitations: Resident-based (where workers live).

label: Unemployment rate (ACS)
sentence_label: unemployment rate (ACS)
definition: Share of the civilian labor force aged 16 and over that is unemployed (5-year period average).
universe: Civilian labor force 16 years and over
breaks: B23025 is not published in the 2005-2009 release.
limitations: Period average; for annual unemployment use BLS LAUS, which differs in method and timing.

label: Bachelor's degree or higher
sentence_label: share of adults 25 and over with a bachelor's degree or higher
definition: Share of adults aged 25 and over with a bachelor's degree or higher.
breaks: B15003 is not published in the 2005-2009 release.

label: Households receiving SNAP
sentence_label: share of households receiving SNAP
definition: Share of households that received Food Stamps/SNAP in the past 12 months.
limitations: Survey reports of receipt are known to understate administrative caseloads.

label: Housing units
sentence_label: number of housing units
definition: Total housing units (ACS 5-year period estimate).
breaks: Controlled to housing unit estimates for counties and larger areas.

label: Homeownership rate
sentence_label: homeownership rate
definition: Share of occupied housing units that are owner-occupied.

label: Vacancy rate
sentence_label: vacancy rate
definition: Share of all housing units that are vacant (any reason, including seasonal).
limitations: Includes seasonal and other vacant units, not only units for rent or sale.

label: Median home value
sentence_label: median home value
definition: Median owner-reported value of owner-occupied housing units, in dollars of the final year of the period.
breaks: Top value bins expanded in 2015 (above $1,000,000); bins are read per release.
suppression: Medians in open-ended intervals are shown as bounds.
limitations: Owner estimates, not sale prices; combined-area medians interpolated from bins without MOE.

label: Median gross rent
sentence_label: median gross rent
definition: Median monthly gross rent (contract rent plus utilities) of renter-occupied units paying cash rent, in dollars of the final year of the period.
universe: Renter-occupied housing units paying cash rent
breaks: Top rent bins expanded in 2015; bins are read per release.
suppression: Medians in open-ended intervals are shown as bounds.
limitations: Combined-area medians interpolated from bins without MOE.

label: Renters paying 30% or more of income on rent
sentence_label: share of renter households paying 30% or more of income on rent
definition: Share of renter households (with computed ratio) whose gross rent is 30 percent or more of household income.
universe: Renter-occupied units with gross rent as a percentage of income computed
limitations: Excludes units with no cash rent or zero/negative income (not computed).

label: Children under 5
sentence_label: number of children under 5
definition: Resident children under age 5.

label: Own children under 6
sentence_label: number of own children under 6
definition: Children under 6 living with one or both parents (own children in families and subfamilies).
universe: Own children under 18 in families and subfamilies
limitations: Excludes children not living with a parent (e.g. with grandparents only).

label: Children under 6 with all parents in the labor force
sentence_label: share of young children (under 6) whose parents all work
definition: Share of own children under 6 whose parent(s) living with them are all in the labor force: both parents in two-parent families, or the parent in one-parent families. A standard indicator of potential need for child care, not of care used.
universe: Own children under 6 in families and subfamilies
limitations: Estimated potential need only: says nothing about care arrangements, hours, or supply.

label: Mean travel time to work
sentence_label: mean travel time to work (minutes)
definition: Average one-way commute in minutes for workers 16 and over who did not work from home.
universe: Workers 16 years and over who did not work from home
breaks: B08012 structure differs in the 2005-2009 release.

label: Households with a broadband subscription
sentence_label: share of households with a broadband subscription
definition: Share of households with a broadband internet subscription of any type.
breaks: Internet questions were added to the ACS in 2013 and revised in 2016; 5-year periods before 2016-2020 mix the old and new wording, so compare them with caution.
limitations: Subscription, not availability; history is short (two non-overlapping periods).

label: Population (annual estimate)
sentence_label: estimated population
definition: Resident population on July 1 estimated by the Population Estimates Program from census counts, births, deaths and migration.
table_or_series: PEP totals (NST-EST2025, CO-EST2025, SUB-EST2025; intercensal 2000-2010 and 2010-2020)
breaks: Three separately estimated series (2000-2010 and 2010-2020 intercensal, Vintage 2025) with different boundaries; drawn as separate lines, never spliced.
limitations: Estimates, not counts; revised each vintage. No estimates for census designated places.

label: Population (census count, 1900-1990)
sentence_label: population (census count)
definition: Resident population counted in each decennial census from 1900 to 1990, on the county boundaries of each census.
table_or_series: Population of Counties by Decennial Census: 1900 to 1990
breaks: County boundary changes over the century are not harmonized; Connecticut planning regions have no counts before 2020.
limitations: Machine-readable copy maintained by NBER; the Census Bureau's original files now return 404.

label: Per capita personal income
sentence_label: per capita personal income
definition: Personal income (wages, proprietors' income, dividends, interest, rent and transfer receipts) divided by resident population, from BEA regional accounts.
breaks: Connecticut: counties through 2023, planning regions 2024 only (no overlap). Some Virginia independent cities are combined with counties.
limitations: A national-accounts measure that differs from ACS per capita income. Place-level data are not published.

label: House price index (2000 = 100)
sentence_label: house price index (2000 = 100)
definition: FHFA all-transactions repeat-sales index of single-family house prices, annual, rebased to 2000 = 100 (nominal).
table_or_series: HPI_AT county, state and national annual files
comparable_span: Varies by county (first year with enough sales)
breaks: Indexes are developmental and revised; counties enter when sales are sufficient.
limitations: Nominal (not adjusted for inflation); cannot be combined across areas; not published for places.

label: New housing units authorized
sentence_label: number of new housing units authorized by building permits
definition: New privately owned housing units authorized by building permits in the year (all structure sizes), estimates including imputation for non-reporting months.
table_or_series: BPS annual county and place files
breaks: Place FIPS codes are available from 2007; the permit-issuing universe was updated from 2023.
suppression: None; values for non-reporting places are imputed (flagged)
limitations: Authorizations, not completions; imputed when a place reported fewer than 12 months.

label: Center-based infant care price (weekly)
sentence_label: median weekly price of full-time center-based infant care
definition: Median weekly full-time price of center-based care for infants (0-23 months) from state market rate surveys, compiled by the Women's Bureau.
universe: Licensed child care centers in state market rate surveys
breaks: State survey methods and years differ; some values are imputed or interpolated (flags in the source).
suppression: No data for Indiana or New Mexico; gaps in other states.
limitations: Prices charged, not family spending or subsidy rates; a county median, not combinable across counties.

label: Center-based preschool-age care price (weekly)
sentence_label: median weekly price of full-time center-based care for preschool-age children
definition: Median weekly full-time price of center-based care for children aged 36-54 months.
universe: Licensed child care centers in state market rate surveys
breaks: State survey methods differ.
suppression: No data for Indiana or New Mexico.
limitations: Prices charged; not combinable across counties.

label: Home-based (family child care) infant price (weekly)
sentence_label: median weekly price of full-time family child care for infants
definition: Median weekly full-time price of regulated family child care (home-based) for infants.
universe: Regulated family child care homes in state market rate surveys
breaks: State survey methods differ.
suppression: No data for Indiana or New Mexico.
limitations: Prices charged; not combinable across counties.

label: Infant center care price as % of median family income
sentence_label: annual price of center-based infant care as a share of median family income
definition: 52 times the median weekly center-based infant price, divided by the county median family income (both nominal, same year), times 100.
breaks: Income is the ACS 5-year median family income carried in the NDCP file.
suppression: No data for Indiana or New Mexico.
limitations: An affordability indicator for a median-income family, not the share any family actually pays.

label: Child day care establishments (with employees)
sentence_label: number of child day care establishments with paid employees
definition: Establishments classified in NAICS 624410 (child day care services) with paid employees in mid-March.
breaks: SIC-based data (1986-1997) are a different classification and are not joined. Noise infusion from 2007; cells under 3 establishments not shown from 2017.
suppression: From 2017, counties with fewer than 3 establishments are not shown (marked suppressed).
limitations: Counts businesses by location, not licensed slots; excludes home-based providers without employees and most public programs.

label: Licensed child care capacity (Texas)
sentence_label: licensed child care capacity
definition: Sum of licensed maximum capacity of Texas licensed centers, licensed child-care homes and registered child-care homes with current operations (listed family homes excluded).
table_or_series: HHSC CCL Daycare and Residential Operations Data (bc5r-88dy)
universe: Regulated child care operations in Texas
breaks: No history: only current records are published.
limitations: Capacity is the licensed maximum (often including school-age slots), not enrollment or vacancies. Counties by name; facility mailing city is not a census place.

label: Unemployment rate (annual average)
sentence_label: unemployment rate
definition: Unemployed persons as a percentage of the civilian labor force, annual average of monthly model-based estimates (not seasonally adjusted).
breaks: 2015 redesign carried back to 2010 for substate areas (break 2009/2010); 2025 annual averages cover 11 months.
limitations: Nation is the sum of state estimates (LAUS has no U.S. series).

label: Civilian labor force (annual average)
sentence_label: civilian labor force
definition: Employed plus unemployed residents 16 and over, annual average.
breaks: Substate break 2009/2010.
limitations: Model-based estimates.

label: Median weekly price: center-based toddler care
definition: Median full-time weekly price charged by child care centers for toddlers (24-35 months) from the state market rate survey for the county or its rate zone; aggregated from six-month bands (MCToddler_flag).
universe: Regulated child care centers covered by state market rate surveys
comparable_span: 2009-2022 within a state whose survey method is stable; check i* imputation flags
breaks: Between-survey years interpolated; 2024 update revised 2008-2018; CA, NC and VA 2022 extrapolated
suppression: Blank for all Indiana and New Mexico counties; 558 of 3,221 counties blank in 2022
limitations: Market prices of regulated care, not family spending; nominal dollars.

label: Median weekly price: center-based school-age care
definition: Median full-time weekly price charged by child care centers for school-age children (ICF used the earliest full-time school age where possible; typically kindergarten).
universe: Regulated child care centers covered by state market rate surveys
comparable_span: 2009-2022 within a state whose survey method is stable
breaks: Between-survey years interpolated; state school-age definitions vary (some 6-12)
suppression: Blank for all Indiana and New Mexico counties; 575 of 3,221 counties blank in 2022
limitations: Full-time weekly rate; many school-age children use part-time before/after-school care priced differently.

label: Median weekly price: family child care home infant care
definition: Median full-time weekly price charged by regulated family child care homes for infants (0-23 months) from the state market rate survey; aggregated from six-month bands (MFCCInfant_flag).
universe: Regulated family child care homes covered by state market rate surveys
comparable_span: 2009-2022 within a state whose survey method is stable; check i* imputation flags
breaks: Between-survey years interpolated; 2024 update revised 2008-2018; CA, NC and VA 2022 extrapolated
suppression: Blank for all Indiana and New Mexico counties; 637 of 3,221 counties blank in 2022
limitations: Home-based regulated care only (unregulated care excluded); nominal dollars.

label: Median weekly price: family child care home toddler care
definition: Median full-time weekly price charged by regulated family child care homes for toddlers (24-35 months) (MFCCToddler_flag).
universe: Regulated family child care homes covered by state market rate surveys
comparable_span: 2009-2022 within a state whose survey method is stable
breaks: Between-survey years interpolated; 2024 update revised 2008-2018
suppression: Blank for all Indiana and New Mexico counties; 641 of 3,221 counties blank in 2022
limitations: Home-based regulated care only; nominal dollars.

label: Median weekly price: family child care home preschool-age care
definition: Median full-time weekly price charged by regulated family child care homes for preschoolers (36-54 months) (MFCCPreschool_flag).
universe: Regulated family child care homes covered by state market rate surveys
comparable_span: 2009-2022 within a state whose survey method is stable
breaks: Between-survey years interpolated; 2024 update revised 2008-2018
suppression: Blank for all Indiana and New Mexico counties; 635 of 3,221 counties blank in 2022
limitations: Home-based regulated care only; nominal dollars.

label: Median weekly price: family child care home school-age care
definition: Median full-time weekly price charged by regulated family child care homes for school-age children.
universe: Regulated family child care homes covered by state market rate surveys
comparable_span: 2009-2022 within a state whose survey method is stable
breaks: Between-survey years interpolated; state school-age definitions vary
suppression: Blank for all Indiana and New Mexico counties; 665 of 3,221 counties blank in 2022
limitations: Full-time weekly rate; nominal dollars.

label: 75th percentile weekly price: center-based infant care
definition: 75th percentile full-time weekly price charged by child care centers for infants (0-23 months); the 75th percentile is the benchmark states are encouraged to use for CCDF subsidy payment rates.
universe: Regulated child care centers covered by state market rate surveys
comparable_span: 2009-2022 within a state whose survey method is stable
breaks: Missing percentiles imputed for 18 states with a lognormal model (flag digit 4); between-survey years interpolated
suppression: Blank for all Indiana and New Mexico counties; 560 of 3,221 counties blank in 2022
limitations: Often imputed from the median; nominal dollars.

label: 75th percentile weekly price: family child care home infant care
definition: 75th percentile full-time weekly price charged by regulated family child care homes for infants (0-23 months).
universe: Regulated family child care homes covered by state market rate surveys
comparable_span: 2009-2022 within a state whose survey method is stable
breaks: Missing percentiles imputed with a lognormal model (flag digit 4); between-survey years interpolated
suppression: Blank for all Indiana and New Mexico counties
limitations: Often imputed from the median; nominal dollars.

label: Median weekly price by six-month age band (centers and family homes)
definition: Median full-time weekly prices for 11 standardized age bands (birth-5 months, 6-11, 12-17, 18-23, 24-29, 30-35, 36-41, 42-47, 48-53 months, 54 months to school age, school age) for centers (MC*) and family child care homes (MFCC*); 75th percentile analogs _75C* and _75FCC*; DOL recommends these granular bands over the aggregates.
universe: Regulated centers and family child care homes covered by state market rate surveys
comparable_span: 2009-2022 within a state whose survey method is stable
breaks: State age definitions aligned to bands within 3 months; imputation flags i{var} per band
suppression: Blank for all Indiana and New Mexico counties
limitations: Read i* flags as text to keep leading zeros (e.g. 00011); nominal dollars.

label: Center infant care price as percent of median family income
definition: Derived: MCINFANT x 52 / MFI x 100, the annualized median weekly center-based infant price divided by county median family income for the same study year (both nominal); mirrors DOL's affordability concept of price as a percent of median family income.
universe: Counties with center infant price and median family income
comparable_span: 2009-2022 within a state whose survey method is stable
breaks: NDCP ACS covariates mix 1-, 3- and 5-year ACS products across years; price breaks as for MCINFANT
suppression: Blank where MCINFANT blank (all IN, NM counties)
limitations: Median family income overstates ability to pay for lower-income families; 52 weeks assumes full-year care. Example: Travis Co TX 2022 = 229 x 52 / 119,793 = 9.9%.

label: Labor force participation rate of women 20-64 with children under 6 only (NDCP)
definition: Percent of women ages 20-64 whose own children are all under 6 who are in the labor force, as carried in NDCP from ACS table S2301; county and state versions.
universe: Women 20-64 with own children under 6 only
comparable_span: 2009-2022 (2008 from 3-year ACS for counties of 20k+ only)
breaks: NDCP ACS inputs mix 1-, 3- and 5-year products; imputed values flagged (iFLFPR_20to64_UNDER6 = 1)
limitations: No MOEs carried; for current values with MOE use ACS S2301 directly.

label: State median weekly childcare price by age group and care type
definition: Median of county full-time weekly prices across a state's counties for infant, toddler, preschool and school-age care, by TYPE (Center or Family), computed by DOL.
universe: Counties in the state with price estimates
breaks: Inherits county NDCP breaks and imputations
suppression: Blank for Indiana and New Mexico (all years)
limitations: Masks within-state variation (DOL cautions against rankings); Texas 2022 Center infant = 185.

label: Share of children living in counties in the least-affordable national quintile
definition: Proportion of a state's infants (also toddlers, preschool, school-age) living in counties whose childcare price as a percent of median family income is in the national least-affordable quintile (quintile 5), by care type.
universe: Estimated child population by care age group in counties with prices
breaks: Child populations by age group imputed from national proportions
suppression: Blank where county prices are missing
limitations: Excludes children in counties without price data (see PCT_VALID_*); affordability based on median family income.

label: Licensed child care centers (Texas)
definition: Count of open operations with operation_type = Licensed Center and operation_status = Y, by county name, city or ZIP; care_type separates Child Care Program, Before/After School Program and School Age Program.
universe: Currently regulated Texas day care operations
breaks: Program types defined by Texas rules; not comparable across states
limitations: Includes school-age-only centers (filter care_type); county names need a FIPS crosswalk; zipcode is ZIP+4 text.

label: Licensed capacity of child care centers and homes (Texas)
definition: Sum of total_capacity for open Licensed Centers, Licensed Child-Care Homes and Registered Child-Care Homes; Listed Family Homes excluded (capacity field fixed at 3).
universe: Open licensed and registered Texas day care operations
units: licensed slots (maximum children at one time)
breaks: Capacity rules differ by operation type
limitations: Regulatory maximum, not enrollment or vacancies; includes school-age slots. Travis Co: centers 55,710 + homes 1,245.

label: Home-based child care operations by type (Texas)
definition: Counts of open Licensed Child-Care Homes, Registered Child-Care Homes and Listed Family Homes (observed capacity: licensed homes 6-12, registered homes 1-12, listed homes all 3).
universe: Currently regulated Texas home-based day care operations
breaks: Listed vs registered vs licensed homes follow Texas rules
limitations: Statewide 2026-09-28: 1,584 licensed, 1,758 registered, 1,375 listed homes; unregulated care not included.

label: Share of licensed centers accepting child care subsidies (Texas)
definition: Licensed Centers with accepts_child_care_subsidies = Y divided by all open Licensed Centers.
breaks: None known
limitations: Self-reported flag; not subsidy enrollment (see TWC CCS data).

label: Licensed child care capacity per 100 children under 5 (Texas)
definition: Derived: sum of total_capacity (Licensed Centers, Licensed and Registered Child-Care Homes) divided by PEP UNDER5_TOT for the county, x 100.
universe: Children under 5 (PEP) and open licensed/registered operations
periods: Current capacity snapshot vs latest PEP year
breaks: Denominator vintage changes yearly
limitations: Capacity is not age-specific and includes school-age slots, so the ratio overstates under-5 supply; excludes unregulated care and public pre-K; not comparable across states.

label: Licensed child care capacity (Indiana centers and homes)
definition: Sum of Capacity for Licensed Center and Licensed Home rows in the FSSA provider listing by county; registered ministries list no capacity.
table_or_series: HTML tables on FSSA Child Care Provider Listings page
universe: Currently licensed Indiana centers and homes
breaks: Unlicensed registered ministries (732) excluded because capacity not listed
limitations: Scraping required; per-age capacities embedded in Age Range Served text (e.g. Infant (8)). Marion Co: centers 19,691 + homes 4,530.

label: Child care providers by type (Indiana)
definition: Counts of Licensed Center, Licensed Home and Unlicensed Registered Ministry rows by county.
table_or_series: HTML tables on FSSA Child Care Provider Listings page
universe: Currently licensed or registered Indiana child care providers
breaks: None known
limitations: Statewide: 770 centers, 1,813 licensed homes, 732 registered ministries; license-exempt legal providers not listed.

label: Capacity in Paths to QUALITY Level 3-4 programs (Indiana)
definition: Sum of Capacity for licensed centers and homes whose PTQ Level is Level 3 or Level 4 (highest levels observed); also as a share of all licensed capacity.
table_or_series: HTML tables on FSSA Child Care Provider Listings page
universe: Currently licensed Indiana centers and homes
breaks: Rating system rules may change
limitations: Quality rating is a program rating at a point in time; ministries have ratings but no capacity.

label: Licensed child care capacity per 100 children under 5 (Indiana)
definition: Derived: sum of Capacity for licensed centers and homes divided by PEP UNDER5_TOT for the county x 100.
periods: Current capacity snapshot vs latest PEP year
breaks: Denominator vintage changes yearly
limitations: Capacity includes school-age slots; ministries excluded; Marion Co: (19,691 + 4,530) / 69,906 = 34.6 per 100.

label: Regulated child care capacity (New York OCFS programs)
definition: Sum of total_capacity for programs with facility_status License or Registration (optionally incl. Pending Revocation or Suspended), by county, ZIP or school district and program_type (DCC, SDCC, GFDC, FDC, SACC).
universe: OCFS-regulated child care programs (excludes NYC day care centers)
breaks: None known
suppression: Addresses/coordinates withheld for opted-out providers (county and ZIP retained)
limitations: NYC counties undercount (NYC centers regulated by DOHMH); SACC capacity (school-age) is large and should be separated.

label: Infant and toddler center capacity (New York OCFS)
definition: Sum of infant_capacity (children up to 18 months) and toddler_capacity (18-36 months) for day care centers.
breaks: None known
limitations: Family and group family homes report mixed-age capacity (capacity_description) not split by age.

label: Licensed child care capacity (California CCLD)
definition: Sum of facility_capacity for facilities with facility_status LICENSED or ON PROBATION, by county or ZIP and facility_type (Day Care Center, Infant Center, School Age Day Care Center, Single Licensed Child Care Center, Family Day Care Home).
table_or_series: CHHS ccl-facilities CSVs (Child Care Centers; Family Child Care Homes)
periods: CSV snapshot 2025-05-25 (ArcGIS layer current for centers)
breaks: Licensing categories set by California rules
suppression: Family home street addresses withheld (ZIP retained)
limitations: Family home capacity is mostly the maximum 14; snapshot older than ArcGIS layer.

label: Licensed child care capacity (Colorado CDEC)
definition: Sum of total_licensed_capacity by county and provider_service_type; age-specific fields (infant, toddler, preschool, school-age) also available.
universe: Colorado non-24-hour licensed child care facilities
periods: Current monthly snapshot; monthly 2017-07 to 2019-05 in time series
breaks: Gap after May 2019 in published history
limitations: Resident camps and school-age centers inflate totals; age capacities overlap so do not sum.

label: Licensed child care center and school-age capacity (Washington DCYF)
definition: Sum of licensecapacity for latestoperatingstatus = Active by facilitytypegeneric (CHILD CARE CENTER, SCHOOL-AGE PROGRAM, OUTDOOR NATURE BASED PROGRAM) and county.
universe: Active Washington center and school-age licenses
breaks: None known
limitations: Family home child care capacity not included in this dataset.

label: State program uptake rate among eligible children (Washington)
definition: metric_type = Uptake Rate: percent of children served by WCCC and/or ECEAP out of all children in the same geography, program eligibility group, age group and SMI bin.
universe: Children in eligibility groups defined by DCYF (ACS-based)
breaks: Dataset restructured to long format
suppression: Program served 1-9 suppressed; populations under 50 removed
limitations: Washington-specific definitions; modeled denominators.

label: Estimated children with unmet childcare need (Washington)
definition: metric_type = unserved Estimate: modeled number of children in the population group not served by state programs or private-pay care, by geography, age group and SMI bin.
comparable_span: Latest quarter only for substate geographies
breaks: Dataset restructured to long format
suppression: Program served 1-9 suppressed; populations under 50 removed
limitations: Modeled estimate; definitions specific to Washington.

label: Licensed child care capacity (Missouri)

From 2007 values are published with noise; before 2017 the employment and payroll of small cells were withheld (shown as suppressed); from 2017 cells with fewer than 3 establishments are not published (suppressed). breaks: NAICS revisions reclassify some establishments

breaks: NAICS revisions

breaks: PIR form changes yearly

limitations: State only; FY2023 Indiana 24,700, Texas 92,100.

universe: Children in families receiving CCDF assistance
breaks: Quarter labels may not match calendar quarters

label: Children under 3 in households
sentence_label: children under 3 living in households
definition: Children under 3 living in households.

label: Children aged 3 and 4 in households
sentence_label: children aged 3 and 4 living in households
definition: Children aged 3 and 4 living in households.
limitations: Preschool-age population; not published for block groups.

label: Children under 18
sentence_label: children under 18
definition: Residents under 18, including those living in group quarters.
limitations: B09001_010 gives children in group quarters.

label: Children under 5 (Population Estimates)
definition: UNDER5_TOT from PEP county characteristics (July 1 estimate; YEAR code 7 = 7/1/2025 in Vintage 2025).
breaks: Each vintage revises all years; earlier decades in separate series

label: Children under 6 with all parents in the labor force

sentence_label: share of children aged 6 to 17 whose parents are all in the labor force
definition: Share of own children aged 6 to 17 whose parents living with them are all in the labor force: both parents in two-parent families, or the parent in one-parent families.

label: Poverty rate, children under 5
sentence_label: poverty rate for children under 5
definition: Share of children under 5 (for whom poverty status is determined) living below the poverty threshold.

label: Poverty rate, children under 6
sentence_label: poverty rate for children under 6
definition: Share of children under 6 (for whom poverty status is determined) living below the poverty threshold.
universe: Population under 6 for whom poverty status is determined
limitations: Aligns with under-6 working-parent measures; no block groups.

universe: People ages 0-17 for whom poverty status is determined

universe: People under 5 for whom poverty status is determined
breaks: Model inputs changed over time
limitations: State and national only.

label: Children aged 3 and 4 enrolled in school
sentence_label: share of children aged 3 and 4 enrolled in nursery school, preschool or kindergarten
definition: Share of children aged 3 and 4 enrolled in nursery school, preschool or kindergarten, public or private.
limitations: Enrollment in nursery school/preschool or kindergarten, not childcare use or availability; no block groups.

label: Enrolled 3- and 4-year-olds in public school
sentence_label: share of enrolled 3- and 4-year-olds attending public school
definition: Share of enrolled 3- and 4-year-olds attending a public school or program.

definition: Student membership with GRADE = Pre-Kindergarten in CCD school/LEA/state membership files (use TOTAL_INDICATOR subtotal by grade).
universe: Students enrolled in public schools on the count date

limitations: Counts at school locations (map to county via EDGE geocodes); Indiana 2024-25 = 25,678.

label: Adults with a high school diploma or higher
sentence_label: share of adults 25 and over with a high school diploma or higher
definition: Share of adults 25 and over whose highest education is a high school diploma, a GED or alternative credential, or more.

label: Students in kindergarten to grade 12
sentence_label: residents enrolled in kindergarten through grade 12
definition: Residents enrolled in kindergarten through grade 12.
limitations: Resident-based (where students live), unlike CCD school-based counts; no block groups for B14001 (use B14007 for bg).

label: College and graduate students
sentence_label: residents enrolled in college or graduate school
definition: Residents enrolled in undergraduate college, graduate or professional school.
limitations: College students in dorms are counted where they live at college.

label: Public schools (CCD directory)
definition: Count of schools in the CCD directory with operational status Open (optionally New, Added, Reopened, Changed Boundary/Agency), by LEA, state or county (county via EDGE geocode CNTY).
comparable_span: Recent years comparable; check status definitions
breaks: File layouts and status codes changed over time
limitations: 2024-25: 102,178 directory records (99,259 Open); includes special, vocational and alternative schools (filter SCH_TYPE_TEXT).

label: Public school enrollment (CCD membership)
definition: Total student membership at public schools (TOTAL_INDICATOR education unit total) by school or LEA.
universe: Students enrolled in public schools on the count date
breaks: File layouts changed over time
limitations: School-location based (not student residence); school file is 192 MB for 2024-25.

label: Private school enrollment (PSS)
definition: Sum of NUMSTUDS (total students) across private schools by county (PSTANSI + PCNTY); weighted with PFNLWT for estimates.
universe: Private elementary and secondary schools meeting the PSS definition
comparable_span: Cycle to cycle with same frame definitions
breaks: Variable names carry cycle suffixes
limitations: Survey-based with area frame; replicate weights allow standard errors; 22,510 schools in 2023-24.

label: Postsecondary institutions (IPEDS)
definition: Count of institutions (UNITID) in the IPEDS directory (HD) by COUNTYCD or coordinates; filter active institutions (e.g. CYACTIVE).
universe: Title IV and other institutions reporting to IPEDS
breaks: Institutional mergers and closures
limitations: HD2024 = 6,072 institutions; branch campuses may report separately or combined.

definition: EFTOTLT where EFALEVEL = 1 (all students total) in EF{YYYY}A joined to HD county codes.
universe: Students enrolled in fall at reporting institutions
breaks: Imputed values flagged (XEFTOTLT)
limitations: Institution-location based (online students counted at institution); EFALEVEL values padded (' 1'); EF2023A total = 19,703,000.

label: Workers who drove alone to work
sentence_label: share of workers who drove alone to work
definition: Workers 16+ who usually drove alone in a car, truck or van as a share of all workers 16+ (denominator includes people who worked from home).
breaks: Working from home rose sharply in periods that include 2020 and later, which lowers the shares of other ways of getting to work.
limitations: Usual mode in the reference week; large MOEs for tracts and block groups; resident-based (where workers live)

label: Workers who carpooled
sentence_label: share of workers who carpooled to work
definition: Workers 16+ who usually carpooled in a car, truck or van as a share of all workers 16+.
limitations: Large MOEs for small areas; usual mode only

label: Workers commuting by public transportation
sentence_label: share of workers commuting by public transportation
definition: Workers 16+ whose usual mode was public transportation (bus, subway, commuter rail, light rail or streetcar, ferry; taxi excluded) as a share of all workers 16+.
limitations: Near zero in most rural areas; MOEs large relative to small shares

label: Workers commuting by rail
sentence_label: share of workers commuting by subway, commuter rail or light rail
definition: Workers 16+ commuting by subway or elevated rail, long-distance train or commuter rail, or light rail, streetcar or trolley, as a share of all workers 16+.
comparable_span: Sum approximately comparable across the 2019 change; individual lines not comparable
limitations: Small counts outside large metros; do not compare individual sub-lines across 2019 Line order changed in the 2015-2019 release (subway, commuter rail, light rail); lines 12-14 cover all rail modes in every release.

label: Workers who walked to work
sentence_label: share of workers who walked to work
definition: Workers 16+ who usually walked to work as a share of all workers 16+.
limitations: Small shares with large relative MOEs; college towns and military bases stand out

label: Workers who bicycled to work
sentence_label: share of workers who bicycled to work
definition: Workers 16+ who usually commuted by bicycle as a share of all workers 16+.
limitations: Very small shares; MOEs often exceed estimates at tract/BG level

label: Workers who worked from home
sentence_label: share of workers who worked from home
definition: Workers 16+ who usually worked from home in the reference week as a share of all workers 16+.
breaks: Working from home rose sharply in periods that include 2020 and later, which lowers the shares of other ways of getting to work.
limitations: Reference-week concept; hybrid workers classified by where they worked most that week

label: Workers with commutes of an hour or more
sentence_label: share of commuters traveling an hour or more to work
definition: Workers 16+ who did not work from home with usual one-way travel time of 60 minutes or more, as a share of all such workers.

limitations: Self-reported usual travel time; small-area MOEs

label: Households without a vehicle
sentence_label: share of households without a vehicle
definition: Households with no car, van or truck (one-ton or less) kept at home for household use, as a share of all households.
limitations: B08201 has no block-group rows; for block groups use (B25044_003+B25044_010)/B25044_001

label: Renter households without a vehicle
sentence_label: share of renter households without a vehicle
definition: Renter-occupied housing units with no vehicle available as a share of all renter-occupied units.

label: Vehicles available per household
sentence_label: average number of vehicles available per household
definition: Aggregate number of vehicles available divided by occupied housing units.
limitations: Aggregate is top-coded by the response categories; MOE of a ratio must be approximated

label: Jobs located in the area (all jobs)
definition: Count of all jobs (job type JT00, segment S000) whose workplace census block lies in the area, summed from WAC C000.
universe: Jobs in state UI records plus federal (OPM) employment
breaks: Federal job types from 2010; job frame ages 14-99 from 2012; no WAC files for AK 2017-2023, MI 2022-2023, MA 2002-2010, DC 2002-2009

label: Jobs paying $1,250 per month or less (%)
definition: WAC jobs with earnings of $1,250 per month or less (CE01) as a share of all jobs (C000) located in the area.
universe: Jobs in state UI records plus federal (OPM) employment
breaks: Earnings bands are fixed nominal thresholds since 2002, so low-earnings shares drift down with wage inflation; same state-year gaps as WAC
suppression: State-years without employment data lack WAC files
limitations: Monthly earnings include part-time and part-month jobs; not an hourly wage measure

label: Jobs located in the area by NAICS sector (%)
definition: WAC jobs in each of 20 NAICS sectors (CNS01-CNS20) as shares of all jobs (C000) located in the area.
universe: Jobs in state UI records plus federal (OPM) employment
breaks: Federal jobs from 2010 raise public administration (CNS20) counts; state-year gaps as WAC
suppression: State-years without employment data lack WAC files
limitations: Sector from employer records; workplace location of multi-establishment employers may be imputed (LEHD method, not verified here)

label: Employed residents (primary jobs held by residents)
definition: Count of primary jobs (JT01) held by workers whose residence block is in the area, from RAC C000; approximates employed residents.
universe: Primary jobs of residents (state UI plus federal employment)
breaks: Federal job types from 2010; RAC for states lacking employment data still includes residents employed in other states
limitations: Self-employed residents not counted; residence locations partly modeled

label: Jobs per employed resident
definition: Primary jobs located in the area (WAC JT01 C000) divided by primary jobs held by area residents (RAC JT01 C000); values above 1 indicate a net importer of workers.
breaks: Missing WAC state-years (AK 2017-2023, MI 2022-2023) make the ratio invalid there
limitations: Sensitive to area size and to missing out-of-state data

label: Employed residents who work in the same area (%)
definition: OD primary jobs (JT01) with both home and work blocks inside the area divided by all primary jobs held by area residents (RAC JT01 C000).
table_or_series: OD {st}_od_main_JT01_{YEAR}.csv.gz (plus other states' aux files for cross-state commuting)
universe: Primary jobs held by area residents
breaks: Missing OD state-years (AK 2017-2023, MI 2022-2023) and 2010 federal-job addition
limitations: Larger areas mechanically retain more workers; cross-state work requires the destination state's aux file

label: Jobs filled by workers living outside the area (%)
definition: OD primary jobs (JT01) with the work block inside the area and the home block outside it, divided by all primary jobs located in the area (WAC JT01 C000).
universe: Primary jobs located in the area
breaks: Missing OD state-years (AK 2017-2023, MI 2022-2023); federal jobs from 2010
limitations: Aux files hold in-state jobs of out-of-state residents; sensitive to area size

label: Motor vehicle traffic deaths
definition: Number of people who died within 30 days of a crash on a trafficway open to the public that occurred in the area (sum of FATALS in accident.csv by STATE and COUNTY of the crash).
universe: Fatal crashes on trafficways customarily open to the public
breaks: Annual Report File values revised in the Final file; GSA county and city codes occasionally split
limitations: Counted where the crash occurred, not where victims lived; small annual counts in small counties (use 3-5 year sums)

label: Traffic deaths per 100,000 residents
definition: FARS deaths from crashes in the area divided by the area's resident population (external Census population estimates) times 100,000.
breaks: As for traffic_fatalities_fars; population denominators change with each estimates vintage
limitations: Numerator by crash location but denominator by residence; unstable for small counties (pool years)

definition: Persons killed (INJ_SEV = 4) whose person type is pedestrian (PER_TYP = 5) or bicyclist (PER_TYP = 6), counted by county of the crash.
comparable_span: 1975-2024 (check person-type code changes in the manual)
breaks: Person-type attribute codes documented by year in the Analytical User's Manual
limitations: Very small counts in most counties; use multi-year sums

label: Households with cable, fiber optic or DSL broadband

sentence_label: share of households whose only internet subscription is a cellular data plan
definition: Households with a cellular data plan and no other type of internet subscription as a share of all households.

limitations: Indicator of mobile-only connectivity; data caps and speeds not captured

label: Households without an internet subscription
sentence_label: share of households without an internet subscription
definition: Households with internet access but no subscription plus households with no internet access, as a share of all households.
breaks: Internet questions were added to the ACS in 2013 and revised in 2016; 5-year periods before 2016-2020 mix the old and new wording, so compare them with caution.
limitations: Access without subscription includes free public or shared connections

label: Households without a computer
sentence_label: share of households without a computer, smartphone or tablet
definition: Households reporting no computing device of any type (desktop, laptop, smartphone, tablet or other) as a share of all households.
breaks: Internet questions were added to the ACS in 2013 and revised in 2016; 5-year periods before 2016-2020 mix the old and new wording, so compare them with caution.
limitations: Device presence only; working condition and sharing not measured

label: Households with a smartphone as their only computer
sentence_label: share of households whose only computing device is a smartphone
definition: Households with a smartphone and no other type of computing device as a share of all households.
breaks: Internet questions were added to the ACS in 2013 and revised in 2016; 5-year periods before 2016-2020 mix the old and new wording, so compare them with caution.
limitations: Captures device dependence, not internet subscription

label: Units with terrestrial fixed broadband of at least 100/20 Mbps (%)
definition: Share of units at broadband serviceable locations in the geography where providers report fixed terrestrial service with maximum advertised speeds of at least 100/20 Mbps.
universe: Units at broadband serviceable locations (Location Fabric)

definition: One minus the share of units at broadband serviceable locations served by fixed terrestrial technologies at 25/3 Mbps or more.
universe: Units at broadband serviceable locations (Location Fabric)
breaks: Not comparable with Form 477; Fabric and provider revisions between vintages
limitations: Excludes satellite by construction; advertised availability only

definition: Population with one or more providers of fixed terrestrial broadband (ADSL, cable, fiber, other copper, fixed wireless; satellite excluded) at 25/3 Mbps, as a share of total population, summing urban/rural and tribal rows.

periods: Semiannual December 2016 to June 2021 (Area Tables on opendata.fcc.gov)
breaks: Series ended June 2021; not comparable with BDC; V1/V2 revisions within periods
limitations: Census-block method counts a block as served if one location can be served, overstating coverage

label: Persons who use the internet (%)
definition: Persons age 3+ (not active-duty military) who use the internet at any location, as a share of that population.
universe: Persons age 3+ not in active-duty military
periods: CPS supplement waves Dec 1998 to Nov 2023
breaks: Question wording and universes vary by wave; some metrics marked legacy
limitations: State SEs about 1-2 points; use, not availability; uncertainty value used here means a published survey SE

label: Households where no one uses the internet at home (%)
definition: Households in which no member uses the internet at home, as a share of households (reference persons).
periods: CPS supplement waves Dec 1998 to Nov 2023
breaks: Question wording varies by wave
limitations: State-level only; complements ACS subscription measures

label: Violent crime offenses reported by a police agency
definition: Offenses of murder and nonnegligent manslaughter, rape, robbery and aggravated assault known to the agency (SRS, or NIBRS converted to summary form), summed over months.
universe: Offenses known to law enforcement in the agency's jurisdiction
breaks: 2021 NIBRS-only year left many agencies missing; agency SRS-to-NIBRS transitions change counting rules
suppression: Months an agency did not report are absent or null in API output
limitations: Reported crime only; FBI advises against rankings; agency jurisdictions differ from Census places and can overlap

label: Violent crimes per 100,000 population (agency)
definition: Violent offenses known to the agency divided by the population the FBI assigns to the agency, times 100,000.
breaks: 2021 coverage gap; NIBRS transitions
suppression: Months an agency did not report are absent or null in API output
limitations: FBI discourages rankings; only compare a city to its state and the state to the nation

label: Property crimes per 100,000 population (agency)
definition: Property crime offenses (burglary, larceny-theft, motor vehicle theft; check arson treatment) known to the agency divided by agency population, times 100,000.
breaks: 2021 coverage gap; NIBRS transitions
suppression: Months an agency did not report are absent or null in API output
limitations: Reporting practices for larceny vary; FBI discourages rankings

label: Population covered by agencies reporting to UCR (%)
definition: Percent of the population served by law enforcement agencies that submitted data for the month, as reported by the Crime Data Explorer.
