universe: Resident population of the state or nation
breaks: Sharp drop in 2021 (NIBRS-only year): US about 77% vs about 96% in 2020 and 95% in 2022
limitations: Use to flag years where agency counts are incomplete

label: Sworn officers per 1,000 residents (agency)
definition: Sworn law enforcement officers (male plus female officers) reported by the agency divided by the agency's participated population, times 1,000.
universe: Law enforcement employees reported to the UCR Program
periods: Annual (2022-2023 checked; earlier years not verified)
limitations: Agency service population differs from Census geography; sheriffs and state police overlap municipal agencies

label: Violent crimes per 100,000 (county, ICPSR-imputed UCR)
definition: County-aggregated UCR Part I violent offenses (murder, rape, robbery, aggravated assault) including ICPSR imputations, divided by county population, times 100,000.
table_or_series: ICPSR county-level detailed arrest and offense files (crimes reported part), e.g. ICPSR 37059
universe: Offenses known to agencies located in the county
breaks: Imputation method introduced in 1994; series ends with data year 2016
limitations: Imputed values; not official FBI releases; check the Coverage Indicator before use

label: UCR county data Coverage Indicator (ICPSR)
definition: ICPSR diagnostic of the quality of aggregated county UCR data (higher values mean more of the county's data come from complete agency reporting).
table_or_series: ICPSR county-level detailed arrest and offense files
breaks: Introduced with the 1994 method change
limitations: Diagnostic only; use to screen county crime rates

label: Violent victimizations per 1,000 persons age 12+ (national)
definition: Rape or sexual assault, robbery, aggravated assault and simple assault victimizations per 1,000 persons age 12 or older (national NCVS estimate), including crimes not reported to police.
table_or_series: NCVS annual Criminal Victimization estimates / N-DASH
breaks: 2006 methodological changes; 2016 sample redesign; 2024 redesigned instrument reported separately
limitations: National context only; uncertainty value used here means a published survey standard error

label: Fire incidents reported to NFIRS by participating departments
definition: Count of NFIRS incident reports classified as fires (incident type 100 series) submitted by participating fire departments, by department or state.
table_or_series: NFIRS Public Data Release basic incident table
universe: Incidents reported by participating fire departments
breaks: NFIRS 4.1 to 5.0 in 1999; 2025 hybrid NFIRS/NERIS year; NERIS replaces NFIRS from 2026
suppression: Non-participating departments and unreported incidents absent
limitations: USFA: raw NFIRS counts are not a proper measure of total fires or losses; participation varies by year

label: National Risk Index composite risk score
definition: National percentile rank (0-100) of composite natural-hazard risk: Expected Annual Loss adjusted by a community risk factor built from social vulnerability and community resilience.
universe: U.S. counties or census tracts (including territories)
breaks: Each version changes hazards, inputs and methods; v1.20 changed inland flooding, tsunami, landslide and social vulnerability inputs
limitations: Relative rank, not absolute risk; planning-level screening

label: Expected annual loss from natural hazards ($)
definition: Modeled average annual loss to buildings, population (dollar-equivalent) and agriculture from 18 natural hazards.
breaks: Version changes as for nri_risk_score_nri
limitations: Population losses valued as dollar equivalents; tract sums may not equal county values (use published geography)

label: NRI social vulnerability score
definition: National percentile rank of social vulnerability used in the NRI; in v1.20 based on Census Community Resilience Estimates.
breaks: Source changed to Census CRE in v1.20; not comparable with earlier NRI versions
limitations: Relative rank; underlying estimates carry survey error not shown

label: NRI community resilience score
definition: National percentile rank of community resilience from a FEMA-modified version of the HVRI Baseline Resilience Indicators for Communities (2020).
breaks: Based on 2020 BRIC inputs
limitations: Composite of many indicators; relative rank

label: NRI heat wave risk score
definition: National percentile rank of heat wave hazard-type risk (expected annual loss from heat waves adjusted by the community risk factor).
breaks: Heat wave period of record 2005-2024 in v1.20
limitations: Loss-based hazard risk, not a count of hot days

label: Severe weather events recorded (county-based)
definition: Number of Storm Events records with CZ_TYPE = C for the county in a year (zone-based records need an NWS zone-to-county correlation).
universe: Storm Data events reported by NWS offices
breaks: Event types limited before 1996 (tornado only 1950-1954; tornado, thunderstorm wind and hail 1955-1995)
limitations: Counts reflect NWS reporting practice; many winter, heat and flood events are recorded by zone

label: Deaths attributed to storm events
definition: Sum of direct and indirect deaths recorded for storm events located in the county (county-based records; zone records need mapping).
breaks: Event coverage expanded in 1955 and 1996
limitations: Heat and cold deaths often recorded by zone; attribution practices vary

label: Storm event property damage (nominal dollars)
definition: Sum of estimated property damage for storm events in the county after converting K, M and B suffixes to dollars; nominal dollars.
breaks: Event coverage expanded in 1955 and 1996
limitations: Rough estimates, often zero or blank; not insured-loss data; adjust for inflation before comparing years

label: Days with AQI above 100
definition: Days in the year when the county AQI (highest monitor) was 101 or higher: days Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups plus Unhealthy, Very Unhealthy and Hazardous days.
variables: Days Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups;Days Unhealthy;Days Very Unhealthy;Days Hazardous (report column labels; file headers not inspected)
universe: Days with AQI in counties with monitors
comparable_span: Check AQI definition changes before long comparisons
breaks: SO2 excluded from county/CBSA AQI summaries from December 8, 2021; AQI breakpoints revised over time; PM2.5 data advisory on recent files
limitations: Driven by the worst monitor; number of monitored days varies by county and year

label: Median daily AQI
definition: Median of the county's daily AQI values for the year (half of days at or below this value).
variables: Median AQI (report label AQI Median; file header not inspected)
universe: Days with AQI in counties with monitors
comparable_span: Check AQI definition changes before long comparisons
breaks: SO2 excluded from summaries from December 8, 2021; breakpoint revisions
limitations: Pollutants monitored differ by county; not population-weighted

label: PM2.5 national percentile (EJScreen 2024, archived)
definition: National percentile of the block group's annual average PM2.5 concentration (tract values from EPA monitor and CMAQ model fusion assigned to block groups).
breaks: EPA discontinued EJScreen in February 2025; indicator years and methods differ between versions
limitations: Screening-level exposure proxy from an unofficial archive; not a risk measure

label: Traffic proximity national percentile (EJScreen 2024, archived)
definition: National percentile of traffic proximity and volume: annual average daily traffic at major roads divided by distance (2020 HPMS).
breaks: EPA discontinued EJScreen in February 2025
limitations: Proxy for exposure to traffic; archived unofficial copy

label: Extreme heat days, May-September (CDC Tracking)
definition: Annual number of extreme heat days from May to September based on modeled daily temperatures (Tracking measure 423; threshold as defined in CDC indicator documentation).
breaks: Full-year version is a separate measure (ID 1427)
limitations: Relative, locally defined threshold; modeled data; API throttles non-token use

label: Area in severe drought or worse (%)
definition: Percent of county area in U.S. Drought Monitor category D2 (severe) or worse; weekly values, commonly averaged over a year.
breaks: None documented; statisticsType 1 is cumulative and 2 is categorical
limitations: Expert-blended weekly assessment; area-based (population-based variant available)

label: Developed land share (%)
definition: Share of 30 m pixels in the area classified as developed (NLCD classes 21-24: open space, low, medium and high intensity) in Annual NLCD land cover.
universe: Land-cover pixels in the area (conterminous U.S.)
breaks: Each collection reprocesses the full series (use one collection); legacy NLCD epochs are not directly comparable
limitations: Classification error; developed open space includes parks and large lawns; CONUS only

label: Mean impervious surface (%)
definition: Average fractional impervious surface across 30 m pixels in the area (Annual NLCD Fractional Impervious Surface product).
breaks: Collections reprocess the full series
limitations: Modeled pixel fractions; CONUS only

label: Democratic share of the presidential vote (%)
definition: Votes for the Democratic presidential candidate divided by total presidential votes in the county.
universe: Ballots with a vote for president
breaks: Check Alaska (districts) and Connecticut (Census planning regions from 2022) before joining to Census counties
limitations: Verify column names and any vote-mode rows in the gated 2000-2024 file before summing

label: Republican share of the presidential vote (%)
definition: Votes for the Republican presidential candidate divided by total presidential votes in the county.
universe: Ballots with a vote for president
breaks: As for presidential_vote_share_dem_medsl
limitations: As for presidential_vote_share_dem_medsl

label: Total votes cast for president
definition: Total votes for president (all candidates) in the county.
universe: Ballots with a vote for president
breaks: Legacy codebook notes Alaska 2004 district returns overstate votes
limitations: Excludes ballots with no presidential vote (undervotes)

label: Presidential turnout as % of citizen voting-age population
definition: Total votes for president divided by the citizen voting-age population (ACS CVAP 5-year estimate ending in the election year), times 100.
table_or_series: countypres_2000-2024 plus CVAP special tabulation County.csv
breaks: Earliest CVAP release is 2005-2009, so 2012 is the first year with an ending-year match
limitations: Denominator is a 5-year average; numerator excludes undervotes; CVAP ignores other eligibility limits

label: Citizens 18+ reporting they were registered (%)
definition: Percent of U.S. citizens age 18+ who reported being registered to vote in the November election (CPS supplement).
table_or_series: Table 4a (vote04a_{YEAR}.xlsx); historical Tables A-5a/A-5b and A-3b
periods: November of even years; state tables from 1972 (presidential) and 1974 (congressional)
breaks: Compare presidential with presidential and midterm with midterm years
limitations: Self-reported and overstated; state-level only; uncertainty value used here means a published CPS margin of error

label: Citizens 18+ reporting they voted (%)
definition: Percent of U.S. citizens age 18+ who reported voting in the November election (CPS supplement).
table_or_series: Table 4a (vote04a_{YEAR}.xlsx); historical Tables A-5a/A-5b and A-3a
periods: November of even years; state tables from 1972 (presidential) and 1974 (congressional)
breaks: Compare like election types
limitations: Self-reports exceed official turnout; state-level only

label: Active registered voters as % of citizen voting-age population
definition: Active registrations reported by the election jurisdiction (A1b) divided by the citizen voting-age population, times 100.
comparable_span: Check item definitions for each cycle
breaks: Jurisdiction types differ by state (towns in WI and New England); list-maintenance practices differ
suppression: Codes -88 (does not apply) and -99 (data not available)
limitations: Can exceed 100% because rolls include movers; town jurisdictions need MCD-level CVAP (12 states only)

label: Voters who voted by mail (%)
definition: Mail votes (F1d) as a share of total voters participating in the general election (F1a).
universe: Voters participating in the general election
comparable_span: Check item definitions for each cycle
breaks: Mode categories and definitions changed across cycles
suppression: Codes -88 and -99; in 2024 F1d valid for 6,133 of 6,461 jurisdictions
limitations: Missing modes in some jurisdictions; state vote-by-mail laws drive levels

label: Residents who volunteered through an organization (%)
definition: Share of state residents covered by the CEV who volunteered with an organization at least once in the 12 months before the September survey.
universe: Civilian noninstitutional population covered by the CEV
breaks: Pre-2017 volunteer supplements are a different series; 2021 wave collected during the pandemic
suppression: No SEs in the open-data table
limitations: Modest state samples; no uncertainty published in this table

label: Residents who report voting in local elections (%)
definition: Share of state residents reporting voting in local elections (CEV measure 'voting in local elections'; see CEV documentation for response coding).
universe: Civilian noninstitutional population covered by the CEV
breaks: As for formal_volunteering_rate_cev
suppression: No SEs in the open-data table
limitations: Self-reported; question coding not verified here

label: Citizen voting-age population
definition: Estimated U.S. citizens age 18+ (CVAP_EST, total line) from the ACS 5-year CVAP special tabulation.
table_or_series: CVAP special tabulation (Nation, State, County, Place, MCD, Tract, BlockGr, CD, SLDUC, SLDLC csv)
breaks: Tract and block-group boundary vintages change with the decennial census; MCD file only for 12 states
limitations: Rounded estimates; MOEs large for small areas

label: Local government property tax revenue per capita
definition: Property tax revenue (item T01, in $000) of local governments divided by population; for a county area sum all local units located there (complete only in census years ending in 2 and 7).
universe: Local governments (counties, municipalities, townships, special districts, school districts)
periods: Annual fiscal years; full universe in census years (2022, 2017, ...)
comparable_span: Census years at 5-year intervals; annual for certainty units
breaks: Sample vs census years; unit ID change (PID to GID); fiscal-year timing differs across governments
limitations: Census cautions that unit data are not an accurate time series; sample years omit many small governments; overlapping governments complicate area totals

label: Local government tax revenue per capita
definition: Sum of all tax item codes (codes beginning with T, e.g. T01 property, T09 general sales, T40 individual income) for local governments divided by population.
variables: all item codes beginning with T;Population (PID file)
periods: Annual fiscal years; full universe in census years
breaks: As for local_gov_property_tax_per_capita_govfin
limitations: Tax assignment follows the collecting government; state-local responsibility splits differ by state

label: Local government long-term debt outstanding per capita
definition: Long-term debt outstanding at the end of the fiscal year (item 49U, in $000) divided by population.
periods: Annual fiscal years; full universe in census years
breaks: Debt item detail differs in older classification versions
limitations: Special-district debt may serve residents outside the county

label: Police protection current operations spending per capita
definition: Police protection current operation expenditure (item E62, in $000) of local governments divided by population.
periods: Annual fiscal years; full universe in census years
breaks: As for local_gov_property_tax_per_capita_govfin
limitations: Excludes capital outlay; county sheriff and municipal police split varies

label: Full-time local government employees per 1,000 residents
definition: Full-time employees across all functions (item code 000) divided by the government's population, times 1,000; sum units for an area in census years.
universe: Government employees in the March pay period
breaks: Sample vs census years; new unit ID from the 2021 revision (May 2024)
limitations: Not FTE; the ID-file population field holds enrollment for school districts and a function code for special districts

label: Current spending per pupil (school district)
definition: Total current expenditures for elementary and secondary education (TCURELSC) divided by fall membership (V33).
periods: Annual FY1990-FY2022 at NCES (FY2024 via Census elsec files)
breaks: Sample-only years FY1991, FY1993 and FY1994; nominal dollars
limitations: Nominal dollars; charter and non-geographic LEAs; regional cost differences

label: School district revenue by source (federal, state, local %)
definition: Federal (TFEDREV), state (TSTREV) and local (TLOCREV) revenue as shares of total revenue (TOTALREV = TFEDREV + TSTREV + TLOCREV).
periods: Annual FY1990-FY2022 at NCES (FY2024 via Census elsec files)
breaks: Sample-only years FY1991, FY1993 and FY1994; one-time federal programs can shift shares in individual years
limitations: State aid formulas differ; pass-through federal aid counted as federal

label: Public library visits per capita
definition: Annual library visits (VISITS) divided by legal service area population (POPU_LSA) for the library system.
breaks: Imputation methods changed FY2006-FY2008 (IMLS bridge study)
suppression: -3 for temporarily closed libraries; imputed values flagged
limitations: Legal service areas do not match Census geographies exactly; visitors include non-residents

label: Public library operating expenditures per capita
definition: Total operating expenditures (TOTOPEXP) divided by legal service area population (POPU_LSA).
breaks: Imputation changes FY2006-FY2008
suppression: Staff expenditure detail set to -9 when total FTE is 2.00 or less (total operating expenditures unaffected)
limitations: Nominal dollars; system-level finance

label: Public library outlets (central, branch, bookmobile)
definition: Number of central libraries, branches and bookmobiles reported by library systems (CENTLIB + BRANLIB + BKMOB), or a count of records in the outlet file.
breaks: Outlet type definitions refined over time
limitations: Outlet file includes temporarily closed outlets flagged by structure code

label: General revenue per capita, fiscally standardized city
definition: General revenue raised by or for the central city FiSC (city plus allocated shares of overlying county, school and special district revenue) per resident, in real dollars.
breaks: Dollar base year ambiguous (About sheet says 2022 dollars; cpi equals 1 in 2023 rows); allocation methods per Lincoln working paper
limitations: Large cities only; allocations are estimates; Lincoln Terms of Service limit reuse

label: Unemployed persons (LAUS)
definition: Residents age 16+ with no job who were available for and actively seeking work (CPS concept), estimated for the area.
breaks: Same as unemployment_rate_laus
suppression: None; '-' with footnote X for Oct 2025
limitations: Sum only non-overlapping areas (cities and city parts overlap counties).

label: Employed persons (LAUS)
definition: Residents age 16+ who worked during the reference week (CPS concept), estimated for the area.
breaks: Same as unemployment_rate_laus
suppression: None; '-' with footnote X for Oct 2025
limitations: Counts employed residents (by residence), not jobs in the area.

label: Civilian labor force (LAUS)
definition: Employed plus unemployed residents age 16+.
breaks: Same as unemployment_rate_laus
suppression: None; '-' with footnote X for Oct 2025
limitations: Level shifts can reflect population-control and method updates rather than real change.

label: Labor force participation rate (LAUS)
definition: Civilian labor force as a percent of the civilian noninstitutional population age 16+.
variables: measure_code 08; population measure_code 09 (not seasonally adjusted only); period M13
geo_levels: state;other:New York city;other:Los Angeles-Long Beach-Glendale metropolitan division
breaks: March 2025 intercensal population controls replaced published population series from 1976; Oct 2025 missing
limitations: Published only for states, DC and two modeled substate areas; not available for counties or most cities.

label: Employment-population ratio (LAUS)
definition: Employed persons as a percent of the civilian noninstitutional population age 16+.
geo_levels: state;other:New York city;other:Los Angeles-Long Beach-Glendale metropolitan division
breaks: Same as labor_force_participation_rate_laus
limitations: States and two modeled substate areas only.

label: Unemployment rate, United States (CPS)
definition: National unemployment rate for the civilian population age 16+ from the Current Population Survey; the national comparator for LAUS areas.
table_or_series: LNU04000000 (not seasonally adjusted; M13 annual average); LNS14000000 (seasonally adjusted)
variables: period M13 = annual average (stored with the monthly NSA series)
breaks: Population controls updated each January; Oct 2025 not collected; 2025 annual average is an 11-month average (footnote 11)
limitations: LAUS publishes no U.S. total; use this series for national comparisons.

label: Labor force participation rate, United States (CPS)
definition: Civilian labor force as a percent of the civilian noninstitutional population age 16+, national.
breaks: Population controls updated each January; 2025 annual average excludes October
limitations: National only.

label: Employment-population ratio, United States (CPS)
definition: Employed persons as a percent of the civilian noninstitutional population age 16+, national.
breaks: Population controls updated each January; 2025 annual average excludes October
limitations: National only.

label: Employment-population ratio
sentence_label: share of residents 16 and over who are employed
definition: Civilian employed residents as a share of all residents 16 and over.
limitations: Age structure strongly affects the ratio; compare with age-specific tables (B23001) when possible.

label: Median earnings of workers
sentence_label: median earnings of workers
definition: Median earnings in the past 12 months of residents 16 and over with earnings, in dollars of the final year of the period.
limitations: Full-time, year-round medians are published only by sex in B20017 (no both-sexes full-time median). For aggregated areas re-estimate from the earnings distribution (B20005), not by averaging medians.

label: Covered employment, all industries (QCEW)
definition: Annual average of monthly employment in UI/UCFE-covered jobs located in the area, all ownerships.
table_or_series: Area slice {year}/a/area/{area_code}.csv; own_code 0, industry_code 10, size_code 0 (agglvl_code 70 county, 50 state, 40 MSA, 30 CSA, 10 U.S.)
universe: Jobs covered by state UI and federal UCFE programs
breaks: Connecticut planning regions from 2024 (counties through 2023); MSA publication reduced to totals from 2025 Q2
limitations: Jobs by worksite, not residents; excludes work not covered by UI/UCFE such as self-employment.

label: Establishments (QCEW)
definition: Annual average number of establishments with UI/UCFE-covered employment in the area.
table_or_series: Area slice {year}/a/area/{area_code}.csv; own_code 0 or 5, industry_code 10 or NAICS
breaks: Same as covered_employment_qcew
suppression: Establishment counts can remain visible when employment and wages are suppressed
limitations: Multi-establishment reporting practices affect counts; not comparable to CBP establishment counts.

label: Average annual pay per job (QCEW)
definition: Total annual wages divided by annual average employment for covered jobs located in the area.
table_or_series: Area slice {year}/a/area/{area_code}.csv; own_code 0 (or 5 for private), industry_code 10
universe: Jobs covered by state UI and federal UCFE programs
breaks: Same as covered_employment_qcew
limitations: Pay per job, not per worker; affected by part-time share and industry mix; nominal dollars (adjust with CPI-U or R-CPI-U-RS).

label: Employment by industry (QCEW)
definition: Annual average covered employment by NAICS sector or supersector; private sector (own_code 5) with government by ownership.
table_or_series: Area slice {year}/a/area/{area_code}.csv; county private NAICS sectors agglvl_code 74 (supersectors 73); government own_code 1, 2, 3 at agglvl_code 71
variables: annual_avg_emplvl by industry_code (e.g., 31-33 manufacturing, 62 health care)
breaks: SIC to NAICS (NAICS history before 2001 reconstructed); MSA industry detail not published from 2025 Q2
suppression: Many detailed cells flagged N (786 of 1,773 rows for Lake County IN 2025)
limitations: Suppressed sectors must be shown as not disclosed, not zero.

label: Employment location quotient by industry (QCEW)
definition: Industry share of local covered employment divided by the same share for the U.S.
breaks: Same as employment_by_industry_qcew
limitations: Relative specialization only; unstable for small industries.

label: Nonfarm payroll jobs (CES State and Area)
definition: Monthly estimate of nonfarm payroll jobs located in the state or metro area, total and by industry where published.
table_or_series: SM{U|S}{state 2}{area 5}{industry 8}{data type 2}, e.g., SMU18294140000000001 (total nonfarm, Lake County-Porter County-Jasper County IN Metro Division, NSA)
variables: data_type 01 (all employees, thousands); industry 00000000 = total nonfarm; period M13 = annual average
breaks: Annual benchmark revisions; OMB metro delineation updates
limitations: No county estimates; recent months preliminary.

label: Employment by occupation (OEWS)
definition: Estimated wage-and-salary employment by detailed occupation (SOC) in the area, May reference period.
universe: Nonfarm wage and salary jobs (excludes self-employed)
breaks: Occupation (SOC) and area definition changes; BLS cautions against time-series use
limitations: Not designed for trends; no county data; excludes self-employed.

label: Median annual wage by occupation (OEWS)
definition: Median annual wage for an occupation in the area (hourly median x 2,080 where hourly wages are published).
universe: Nonfarm wage and salary jobs in the occupation
breaks: Wage data from older panels are aged to the current reference period
suppression: Top-coded at $115.00/hour or $239,200/year (footnote 5); footnote 8 estimate not released
limitations: Not designed for trends.

label: Mean annual wage by occupation (OEWS)
definition: Mean annual wage for an occupation in the area.
universe: Nonfarm wage and salary jobs in the occupation
breaks: Same as median_annual_wage_oews
limitations: Weight by occupational employment (datatype 01) when combining.

label: Personal income (BEA)
definition: Total income received by or on behalf of residents: earnings, dividends/interest/rent and transfer receipts, less social insurance contributions, plus residence adjustment.
breaks: Connecticut geography switch in 2024; Alaska area changes; Broomfield CO from 2002
limitations: Current dollars; BEA U.S. total is the sum of states and DC.

label: Per capita personal income (BEA, states)
definition: State personal income divided by midyear population.
breaks: Revisions each release; population vintage differs from the county (CAINC1) release
limitations: Use one release for both state and county values when showing parents together.

label: Real per capita personal income (BEA, states)
definition: State per capita personal income in constant 2017 dollars, adjusted for regional price levels and inflation using BEA's real personal income method.
variables: LineCode 2 (constant 2017 dollars); LineCode 1 real personal income (millions of 2017 dollars)
breaks: Whole series revised each release
limitations: States only; mixes spatial and temporal price adjustment.

label: Personal current transfer receipts as share of personal income (BEA)
definition: Government transfer receipts (Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, income maintenance, unemployment insurance, veterans and other) as a percent of personal income.
variables: LineCode 50 (transfer receipts); LineCode 10 (personal income); LineCode 130 (per capita transfers)
breaks: Same as personal_income_bea
limitations: Includes Medicare/Medicaid in-kind benefits, so it is not a poverty indicator by itself.

label: Income maintenance benefits per capita (BEA)
definition: Income maintenance benefits (largely SSI, EITC, family assistance, general assistance, WIC, SNAP and other assistance) per resident.
breaks: Program changes (e.g., SNAP, EITC) shift levels; Connecticut geography switch 2024
limitations: Program dollars, not recipients; nominal dollars.

label: Earnings by place of work (BEA)
definition: Wages and salaries, supplements and proprietors' income earned in the county's jobs, before residence adjustment.
table_or_series: CAINC4 LineCode 35 (wages and salaries LineCode 50; proprietors' income LineCode 70)
variables: LineCode 35; LineCode 50; LineCode 60; LineCode 70; LineCode 42 (adjustment for residence)
breaks: Same as personal_income_bea
limitations: Workplace-based complement to resident personal income; the residence adjustment (LineCode 42) shows net commuter earnings flow.

label: Earnings by NAICS industry (BEA)
definition: Earnings by place of work by NAICS industry (e.g., LineCode 1000 finance and insurance; 2000 government and government enterprises).
variables: Industry LineCodes per CAINC5N definition file
breaks: SIC to NAICS break at 2001; Connecticut geography switch 2024
suppression: (D) heavy in small counties (67,619 cells in the CAINC5N Indiana file); (NA)
limitations: Suppressed industries must be shown as not disclosed.

label: Gross domestic product, current dollars (BEA, counties)
definition: Value added by production located in the county, in current dollars.
breaks: Connecticut planning regions from 2024; metro GDP discontinued (sum counties instead)
limitations: Not a measure of resident income; volatile for small counties dominated by one industry.

label: Real GDP (BEA, counties)
definition: County GDP in chained 2017 dollars and its chain-type quantity index; used for real growth rates.
table_or_series: CAGDP1 LineCode 1 (real GDP); LineCode 2 (quantity index); CAGDP9 by industry
breaks: Reference-year and comprehensive-update revisions; Connecticut 2024 switch
limitations: Chained dollars are not additive; compare growth rates rather than levels across areas.

label: GDP by industry (BEA, counties)
definition: Current-dollar GDP by NAICS sector and industry groups (e.g., LineCode 12 manufacturing; 70 health care and social assistance; 83 government).
variables: LineCode 1 all industry total; 2 private industries; sector LineCodes per CAGDP2 definition file
breaks: Same as gdp_current_dollars_bea
suppression: (D) not shown to avoid disclosure (10,337 cells in the CAGDP2 Indiana file); (NA); (NM)
limitations: Industry detail heavily suppressed for small counties.

label: Regional Price Parity (BEA)
definition: Price level of an area relative to the U.S. average (U.S. = 100) for all items and components (goods; housing; utilities; other services).
table_or_series: SARPP (states), MARPP (MSAs), PARPP (metro/nonmetro portions); LineCode 1 all items
variables: LineCode 1 all items; 2 goods; 3 services: housing; 4 services: utilities; 5 services: other
geo_levels: nation;state;cbsa;other:metro and nonmetro portions of states
breaks: Full series revised each release
limitations: Spatial price levels for a single year; not an inflation index; no county or city values.

label: Mean household income
sentence_label: mean household income
definition: Aggregate household income divided by the number of households, in dollars of the final year of the period.
suppression: 90% MOE published (ratio MOE must be approximated)
limitations: Sensitive to very high incomes; pair with the median.

label: Gini index of income inequality
sentence_label: Gini index of household income inequality
definition: Gini index of household income (0 = perfect equality, 1 = maximal inequality).
suppression: 90% MOE published; not published for block groups
limitations: Cannot be combined across areas.

label: Poverty rate by age group (ACS)
definition: Share below poverty for age groups under 6, 6-11, 12-17, 18-59, 60-74, 75-84 and 85+.
universe: Population for whom poverty status is determined
breaks: No standard 2020 1-year release
suppression: 90% MOE published; not published for block groups
limitations: Child rate (0-17) = sum of B17020_003 to _005 over the same age groups at all income levels.

label: People with income below twice the poverty level
sentence_label: share of people with income below twice the poverty level
definition: Share of people with income-to-poverty ratio under 2.00 (a common low-income or near-poor measure).
universe: Population for whom poverty status is determined
limitations: Uses national poverty thresholds, not local costs.

label: Households with cash public assistance
sentence_label: share of households receiving cash public assistance income
definition: Share of households receiving cash public assistance income (e.g., TANF, general assistance) in the past 12 months.
limitations: Excludes SSI and SNAP (use B19056 and B22001).

label: Households with Supplemental Security Income
sentence_label: share of households receiving Supplemental Security Income
definition: Share of households receiving Supplemental Security Income (SSI) in the past 12 months.
limitations: Household receipt, not number of recipients.

label: Poverty rate, annual estimates
sentence_label: annual poverty rate
definition: Model-based estimate of the share of people (for whom poverty status is determined) with income below the poverty threshold in a single year.
universe: Population for whom poverty status is determined
breaks: The estimates switched from Current Population Survey to American Community Survey inputs in 2005; earlier years are not comparable and are not shown.
limitations: Preferred over ACS 1-year for small counties' single-year rates; aggregate counts (SAEPOVALL_PT / SAEPOVU_ALL) but intervals cannot be combined.

label: People in poverty, annual estimates
sentence_label: number of people in poverty
definition: Model-based estimate of the number of people with income below the poverty threshold in a single year.
universe: Population for whom poverty status is determined
comparable_span: 2005-2024 (ACS-based; counts not comparable across the 2010 benchmark per SAIPE cautions)
breaks: The estimates switched from Current Population Survey to American Community Survey inputs in 2005; earlier years are not comparable and are not shown. County counts before and after the 2010 census benchmark are not strictly comparable.
limitations: Summed county counts have no published interval.

label: Child poverty rate, annual estimates
sentence_label: annual poverty rate for children under 18
definition: Model-based estimate of the share of children under 18 (for whom poverty status is determined) below the poverty threshold in a single year.
universe: Children 0-17 for whom poverty status is determined
breaks: The estimates switched from Current Population Survey to American Community Survey inputs in 2005; earlier years are not comparable and are not shown.
limitations: Ages 0-4 poverty (SAEPOVRT0_4_PT) exists only for states and the nation.

label: Median household income, annual estimates
sentence_label: annual median household income
definition: Model-based estimate of median household income in a single year, in dollars of that year.

suppression: N = not available or not comparable
limitations: Establishment size, not firm size (use SUSB for enterprise size).

breaks: NAICS2022 coding in 2023 data
limitations: Survey estimates with sizeable RSEs at county level.

limitations: Counts businesses, not people; includes part-time and side businesses.

breaks: NAICS vintage changes
suppression: RCPTOT_F S = suppressed; noise flags G, H, J

definition: Number of business applications in the county during the year.
variables: BA2005 to BA2025 (columns); County Code (5-digit FIPS)
breaks: Connecticut geography switch 2022; differentially private noise in the 2026 release
suppression: Differentially private noise; no cell suppression observed
limitations: Applications are not business starts; large 2020-2021 surge.

label: Establishment entry and exit rates (BDS)
definition: Establishments born or exited in the last 12 months as a percent of establishments (BDS definitions).
breaks: Whole time series re-released each year
suppression: Flag variables in API; cells withheld for disclosure
limitations: Volatile for small counties; use multi-year averages.

label: Job creation, destruction and net job creation rates (BDS)
definition: Jobs created by opening/expanding and lost by closing/contracting establishments over 12 months, as rates of the DHS denominator.
breaks: Whole time series re-released each year
suppression: Flag variables in API; cells withheld for disclosure
limitations: Rates use the DHS denominator (DENOM); recompute from counts and denom when aggregating.

label: Jobs by industry sector at workplace (LODES WAC)

limitations: Job counts differ from QCEW/CBP; choose JT00 vs JT01 consistently.

label: Jobs by monthly earnings band at workplace (LODES WAC)

comparable_span: Limited: thresholds are nominal and unchanged since 2002
breaks: Inflation erodes fixed thresholds over time
limitations: Not inflation-adjusted; shares drift upward mechanically.

label: Average monthly earnings of stable jobs (QWI)

universe: Stable (full-quarter) jobs at employers in the area
breaks: Release-specific revisions
suppression: Status flags: 5 suppressed; 9 fuzzed value released
limitations: Weight by EmpS when combining areas; nominal dollars.

limitations: Filers only; mean is skewed by high incomes.

limitations: Nominal class boundaries.

limitations: Experimental; exclude 'did not report' consistently when computing shares.

breaks: Question and design changes across HPS phases and HTOPS; HTOPS tables national only
limitations: Experimental; category wording should be checked per cycle.

breaks: Panel and item changes across files
suppression: None published; compute SEs with replicate weights
limitations: National microdata; requires weighting and replicate-weight variance.

limitations: Reuse requires written permission; not an official statistic.

comparable_span: Check technical briefs for method changes
breaks: Methodology refined across releases
limitations: Model-based; dataset access by request; license terms not verified.

limitations: Record the vintage used; Census published factors (1.02937903 for 2023 to 2024; 1.23070782 for 2019 to 2024) may differ slightly from recomputed ratios.
